fact: On 12 August 2026 the second round of the national DHIS2 data-analysis training opened in Gedaref for primary care, planning and statistics staff of Khartoum, River Nile and Northern states, with training continuing in phases to the remaining states.
title: القضارف تفتتح الجولة الثانية من التدريب القومي على نظام المعلومات الصحية DHIS2 بمشاركة ثلاث ولايات
